title: The 0% Balance Transfer Fee Math

beats.say: Moving your credit card debt to a 0% card sounds like a cheat code.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of a dark metallic credit card resting on wet asphalt under a single sodium streetlamp.

beats.say: It is not free money. The fine print hides a sting.
beats.visual: Low angle shot of a towering concrete bridge pier cutting through heavy evening fog.

beats.say: How much does that upfront balance transfer fee actually cost you?
beats.visual: Silhouette of a lone figure walking across a vast open concrete parking deck at blue hour.

beats.say: Most people assume a 0% APR offer buys you pure savings for a year.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of empty highway lanes reflecting harsh white overhead fluorescent lights.

beats.say: They forget about the 5% fee charged on the total amount you move over.
beats.visual: Close-up of cold raindrops hitting the surface of a deep puddle, rippling under grey skies.

beats.say: If you transfer $6,000 onto that new card, the bank takes $300 instantly.
beats.visual: High angle shot of a single dark car moving down a wet city street at night.

beats.say: Can you pay off that full balance before the zero percent period expires?
beats.visual: Macro shot of rusty metal links on a heavy chain against a dark background.

beats.say: If you pay $300 a month on a $6,000 balance at 24% APR, it takes 26 months.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a massive empty industrial warehouse lit by cold blue window light.

beats.say: That same $6,000 card racks up $1,739 in interest over those 26 months.
beats.visual: Low angle view of a towering rusted steel crane against a heavy overcast sky.

beats.say: If your transfer fee is $300 and you clear the debt in time, you win.
beats.visual: Silhouette of a person standing on a high concrete ridge looking over a dark city skyline.

beats.say: But miss the deadline, and standard APR kicks in on the remaining balance.
beats.visual: Extreme close-up of dark water rushing through a narrow concrete drainage channel.

beats.say: Run the exact math before you move a single dollar.
beats.visual: Wide shot of a single amber light glowing in a massive dark concrete stairwell.

beats.say: Follow for the money rules school never taught you.
beats.visual: Extreme wide shot of a dark empty bridge stretching into thick morning fog.

caption: Moving debt isn't free. Always check the transfer fee math before you leap. #MoneyTips #DebtFree #PersonalFinance #CreditCards #SmartMoney
description: Calculating the exact break-even point and hidden fees when moving high-interest debt to a 0% introductory rate card.
